title_en: Going somewhere: grem v, grem na
card_en: Going somewhere: grem v or grem na, and the place takes the accusative: grem v trgovino. Going out for a drink or a meal takes na: grem na kavo, na kosilo. Domov, home, takes neither.

quick_check.explain_en: Going out for a meal takes na: grem na kosilo.

helper_de: As in German, direction takes the accusative: grem v trgovino, in den Laden; grem na kavo, auf einen Kaffee.
helper_en: English says to the shop, for a coffee and home; Slovenian says v trgovino, na kavo and domov.
